mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_agent_account a WHERE a.sys_user_id != 1
AND a.agent_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{agentName}, '%')

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a1.create_time >= #{todayStart} AND a1.create_time < #{todayEnd} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as todayCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a1.create_time >= #{yesterdayStart} AND a1.create_time < #{yesterdayEnd} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as yesterdayCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a1.create_time >= #{thisWeekStart} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as thisWeekCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a1.create_time >= #{thisMonthStart} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as thisMonthCount FROM t_agent_account a1 WHERE a1.sys_user_id != 1
AND a1.parent_agent_code = #{parentAgentCode}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
SELECT a.agent_code FROM t_agent_account a LEFT JOIN t_order_commission_details ocd ON a.agent_code = ocd.agent_code LEFT JOIN t_order o ON ocd.order_id = o.id WHERE 1=1
AND a.agent_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{agentName}, '%')
AND o.create_time >= #{startTime} AND o.create_time <= #{endTime}
GROUP BY a.agent_code, a.agent_name
SELECT a.agent_code FROM t_agent_account a LEFT JOIN t_order o ON a.agent_code = o.agent_code WHERE 1=1
AND a.agent_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{agentName}, '%')
AND o.create_time >= #{startTime} AND o.create_time <= #{endTime}
GROUP BY a.agent_code, a.agent_name
SELECT a.agent_code FROM t_agent_account a LEFT JOIN t_order o ON a.agent_code = o.agent_code WHERE 1=1
AND a.agent_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{agentName}, '%')
AND o.create_time >= #{startTime} AND o.create_time <= #{endTime}
AND o.status = 1 GROUP BY a.agent_code, a.agent_name
SELECT a.agent_code FROM t_agent_account sub INNER JOIN t_agent_account a ON sub.parent_agent_code = a.agent_code WHERE 1=1
AND a.agent_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{agentName}, '%')
AND sub.create_time >= #{startTime} AND sub.create_time <= #{endTime}
GROUP BY a.agent_code, a.agent_name
SELECT a.agent_code FROM t_agent_account a WHERE 1=0
) temp

choose.otherwise: SELECT 0 as ranking, '' as agentCode, '' as agentName, 0 as level, 0 as statValue WHERE 1=0

mapper.select: SELECT a1.agent_code, a1.agent_name, COUNT(a2.agent_code) as actual_team_count FROM t_agent_account a1 LEFT JOIN t_agent_account a2 ON a1.agent_code = a2.parent_agent_code WHERE a1.parent_agent_code = #{parentAgentCode} GROUP BY a1.agent_code, a1.agent_name ORDER BY a1.create_time DESC
